plant.configure.function_zh: 宿主一次确认安装/冷却/吹扫与明确噪声及热学代理；不是实机传感反馈

sample.load.function_zh: 可信宿主装入一只中心液池；实测条件与单位推断需明确接受；无自动身份识别

sample.unload.function_zh: 可信宿主取出完整样品至外部接收器，保留体积与溶质账本

cover.set.function_zh: 外部盖提升；开盖取消当前采集，保留已完成帧

power.set.function_zh: 逻辑供电；断电取消采集并使空白失效

path.configure.function_zh: 手动选择25–100µm液池光程和窗口材质；不是电动改变液池

filter.select.function_zh: 六位置轮仅安装两滤段；0/π为工程选位映射，随后step有限转动

stage.select.function_zh: 三位置选件有限平移；仅中心槽装池，侧槽为空，不模拟三份样品

temperature.set.function_zh: TCH选件设定；随后step按显式C/H一阶热模型推进

method.configure.function_zh: 设置波数网格/分辨率和全谱积累时间；保留旧谱自己的方法快照

blank.start.function_zh: 闭盖/冷却/吹扫/窗口就绪后采集空白；只有完成全程才生成可用背景

acquisition.start.function_zh: 对匹配空白进行全谱帧积分；ΔA=AL−AR，返回实测参考或明确合成谱

ftir_vcd_measurement.meaning_zh: 条件化全谱IR/VCD积累、空白扣除、有限工程机构与显式热学代理；不是直接对隐藏构型返回标签
equations: DeltaA = A_L - A_R; A=(A_L+A_R)/2; apparent T_L/R=10^(-(A±DeltaA/2)).

Measured reference uses original IR and VCD axes only within their intersection, and preserves source resolution, conditions and inferred-unit evidence; no concentration scaling. Records with unknown VCD ordinate scale reject measured replay.

Scaled reference (measured_reference_scaled, explicit Beer-Lambert assumption): A=A_src*(c/c_src)*(l/l_src), DeltaA=DeltaA_src*(c/c_src)*(l/l_src); requires documented source concentration and path and the same solvent; window material may differ.

Shape mode (measured_ir_vcd_shape): A=measured source A; DeltaA=host_ratio*max(A_source)*VCD_source(nu)/max|VCD_source|, host_ratio>0 so the measured sign is preserved; DeltaA amplitude is an assumption, never reported as measured.
Synthetic IR A=normalized_IR*host_peak_absorbance*(path/100um); synthetic DeltaA=host_ratio*A; concentration is inventory only, not inferred molar absorptivity.
Additional spectral Gaussian FWHM=sqrt(max(0,method_resolution^2-source_resolution^2)); unknown source width is not recovered.

Frame noise_sd = host_noise_sd_1s/sqrt(frame_duration_s); observed full-spectrum mean = sum(frame_duration*frame_observation)/sum(frame_duration). Sample result subtracts the completed matching observed blank.
Filter and optional stage move at explicit finite host speeds; mirror triangular scene phase advances only during acquisition, not OEM travel inferred from resolution.
Caller reference signed cosine=(y dot r)/(|y||r|), nonnegative scale=max(0,y dot r/(r dot r)); normalized coordinates guard overflow, configuration remains not_assigned.

limitations: 任务表与指定p2主规格一致；2018 brochure选件InSb4000–1850 vs旧规格4000–2000、高通滤光片下界2650 vs2700，记录差异，本配置仅标准MCT-V。
brochure液池含50/150µm及25/100/250/500/1000µm选件；任务限定25–100µm，此处不扩展到150µm以上。
CaF2虽然可用于水溶液但不适用1100cm^-1以下；低波数全段须BaF2，禁止水溶液BaF2的未确认兼容配置。
厂家<8e-6ΔAbs仅4cm^-1/20min条件，未指定点间RMS/峰峰定义；不能直接当通用噪声标定。本实现独立宿主白噪声参数，不据此声称达标。
环肽实测在Bruker8cm^-1/16h，不是FVS6000；数据原采样IR约3.86cm^-1、VCD约1.93cm^-1，不等于光学分辨率。
说明中的CREST方法写2.10但Software节2.8；不运行原计算代码、不重新推断构象，两者保留。
已有95个IR库键，其中92个有非空真实IR；3个为空不计入；这些IR模板不提供VCD；不将IR、ECD、构象、对映镜像、重复扫描算作50种实测VCD。当前4种，缺46种。
环肽IR/VCD数据文件未明确纵轴单位；如依据PMA50标准输出推断ΔA，必须保留unit_evidence及原始数值，不能声称原文件单位已证实。
独立重解析原JCAMP发现共享hydrogen_peroxide的3条YUNITS均dispersion index，不是吸收谱，077私库排除；caffeine首选Reflectance不当吸光度，改用原始ABSORBANCE气相谱并保留相态限制。共享库不修改。最终91种NIST吸收/透射IR+4种环肽IR=95种真IR，其中4种VCD。
整机尺寸与质量有据；内部相对位置、外壳壁厚、脚垫、样品盖提升0.12m、滤轮角度/速度、样品台±0.035m行程及干涉镜0.01m代理行程为工程假设。
分件质量、摩擦、真实惯量为null；URDF每件0.1kg及包围盒惯量仅数值代理，不冒充65kg的真实分配。
配置标准MCT-V/两标准滤光区，自动三位置样品台及水冷Peltier作为显式安装选件；未安装则相关操作拒绝。
IR与VCD按明确来源分开保存，带原始轴与SHA；不将数字化曲线重构为假原始干涉图。
只做理想左/右透射与空白差分，加显式白噪声和积分；真实PEM频率、锁相增益、MCT量子效率、氮气输运、液氮消耗、故障概率均未知。
温度以宿主热容/换热系数的一阶能量模型，目标不等于实际温度；检测器冷却/供水/氮气就绪由宿主确认而非伪造传感器。
单滤段一次采集，全范围须分别测两段与匹配空白；Gaussian分辨率卷积为代理，不保证恢复源谱更细分辨率。
构型比较只算调用者曲线的有符号余弦相似与非负尺度残差，输出not_assigned；不读取隐藏标签，不声称量化构型置信度。
USB2/RS232C/电源和吹扫口仅拓扑；外置六读数面板为simulation_only，非原厂GUI。
Session内存权限/幂等不构成OS文件隔离；机器人接触、逆向关节、硬件、HIL及安全认证均not_run。
BaF2对水/湿气长时间暴露会浑浊是厂家材料警示；软件水样拒绝是保守模型约束，不是已验证的OEM自动联锁。滤轮有6个物理位置，本模型仅2标准滤片，角度/未安装孔位为工程映射。
590x670x313mm and65kg describe the documented body only. Internal dimensions/strokes,0/π filter positions and external telemetry are explicit engineering geometry, not OEM CAD or GUI.

Standard MCT-V range85000–320000m^-1 uses two separately selected segments85000–200000 and200000–320000m^-1. Six-position wheel has only two standard installed filters; four unused slots are not extra optical ranges.

Resolution50–1600m^-1 is distinct from grid spacing. Additional Gaussian variance broadens documented source resolution; no deconvolution. Unknown source resolution stays unknown, smoothing is a host proxy; finite source edges use nearest continuation only inside smoothing, exported axis never extrapolates.

Real measured VCD for 40 distinct compounds plus 4 essential oils (44 materials), all on a DeltaA scale: 4 cyclic peptides (DataverseNO FBHIJK, CC0), 33 chiral terpenes and 4 essential oils (Zenodo 7875469, CC BY 4.0; 13 terpene files stored as DeltaA x 1e5 are rescaled per the thesis figure axis) and 3 proteins (Zenodo 12666142, CC BY 4.0; block-mean minus D2O, derived). 10 more compounds would be needed for 50. Proteins come from a 23 um cell outside the 25-100 um range and replay only via the explicit Beer-Lambert mode. NIST IR shapes do not supply VCD. No source spectra were measured on this simulated FVS-6000.

No VCD file states its ordinate unit. Peptide A/DeltaA follows PMA50 documentation; terpene/oil A/DeltaA follows article and thesis figure axes that plot these spectra (the only multiplier, 1e-5 for 13 terpene files, is the thesis axis "DeltaA x 10^5", band heights checked); protein units follow the authors' notebook axis labels. Physical replay requires trusted sample accept_inferred_units; original unit evidence and unknown measured temperature remain visible. No invented 298.15 K source temperature.

Measured replay requires the known source solvent, concentration, path and window and source resolution limit; any unknown temperature/path/concentration (terpenes and oils: per-sample concentration and temperature unknown) needs explicit acceptance. The scaled mode multiplies A and DeltaA by (c/c_src)(l/l_src) only when source c and l are documented (peptides, proteins); this Beer-Lambert linearity is an assumption, not a validated concentration- or temperature-dependent FVS response.

Normalized NIST IR only supplies shape. Explicit host amplitude and DeltaA/A constant are synthetic; source gas/solution/solid phase is not reinterpreted as a measured solution response. No inferred molar absorptivity or absolute configuration.

Host blank IR/bias and independent Gaussian white noise are assumptions. Noise_sd_1s/sqrt(frame duration) and duration-weighted frame means model only added noise; fixed noise in measured templates cannot be averaged away. OEM<8e-6 DeltaAbs applies only400m^-1 and1200s; unknown statistic/distribution is not used as a universal noise calibration.

Whole-spectrum integration frames represent already demodulated FTIR/VCD. Apparent transmittance=10^(-(A±DeltaA/2)) of observed blank-corrected means; these are not raw detector photons and may exceed1 for negative apparent absorption. Interferograms, PEM lock-in, polarization imperfections and Fourier reconstruction are unsupported.

Liquid path25–100µm; BaF2 with aqueous samples rejects, CaF2 below110000m^-1 rejects. No solvent optical constants, saturation calibration, absorption heating, precipitation, evaporation or sample consumption is modeled.

TCH option268.15–363.15K uses explicit host C/H and ideal thermal equilibrium, not measured OEM settling. Energy closure applies only this thermal lump. Optical power, PEM dissipation and full instrument energy balance remain not_run.

Three-position stage is an optional finite motion proxy; this configuration loads one center cell and leaves side holders empty. Acquisition requires center position; no automatic three-sample material transfer.

All clocks advance only in step. Cover handling is trusted external scene authority; sample load/unload conserves intact liquid volume and solute. Detector/purge/water readiness is a host declaration, not measured hardware or certified safety.

Completed frame data survive cancellation. Partial blank never becomes a usable background. Completed blank matches grid/resolution/path/filter/solvent/temperature target; its accumulation time may differ explicitly from sample. Power off clears blank.

Current results keep acquisition method/path snapshots. Owned terminal poll keeps complete public spectrum and averaged sample windows across later operations; cancellation of historical terminal operations cannot stop a new one. Data caches/roles are process-local, not restart persistence or operating-system security.

Reference comparison uses only caller-supplied same-grid signed arrays, returns cosine/nonnegative scale/residual with configuration_assignment=not_assigned. No automatic alignment, uncertainty, stereoisomer matching or hidden identity read.
Robot contact, inverse joint authority, OEM drivers, hardware/HIL, factory noise/IRF calibration, real cooling/purge/LN2 behavior and absolute-configuration validation remain not_run.

coverage.note_zh: CHEM-077 JASCO FVS-6000：3200–850cm^-1、0.5–16cm^-1、25–100µm和本体590×670×313mm/65kg登记；厂家噪声<8e-6ΔAbs仅4cm^-1/1200s，不作通用标定。78几何/79合同组件、22能力(20实现)、32状态、4关节10接口6读数；GLB/URDF/OBJ+MTL/Blend/USD和11预览。66单测/22运行/160几何/540实际双环境/628输出检查及1248条文件SHA通过。91种真实归一化IR+4环肽/33手性萜类/3蛋白质/4精油IR/VCD，40种化合物+4种精油实测VCD（全部ΔA标度，3种蛋白质仅Beer–Lambert换算回放），保留单位推断与原条件，50种化合物要求仍缺10；内部机构与噪声等为工程模型，整体partial，Matterix bridged。；2026-10-15模板补强：红外解码修正10条谱；ΔA尺度真实VCD化合物4→40（另4种精油，共44种材料；萜烯尺度由原作者论文确认，新增3种蛋白CC BY）；GPU5场景540项通过
